propositions: Close-gate verification fails on search-budget exhaustion when criteria are unrefuted but unproven, requiring manual operator re-run despite identical logic succeeding on retry due to verdict cache seeding.
Auto-resume loop must be bounded by count (verify.auto_resume_max, default 2) and progress condition (resumption only if prior attempt increased cache-credited PASS count) to prevent infinite spin.

Resumption invokes verify_completion at the shared seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck call site) with same arguments and ref binding, re-using existing verdict-cache infrastructure without new entry points.

Qualification for auto-resume reuses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to detect insufficient-only failures (all unmet criteria carry framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker, no refutations present).

Per-attempt resumption trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet) recorded in verdict sidecar and output message to surface honest state when exhaustion persists after bounded resumptions.
